about.title: What is DevFest Yaoundé?
about.body: DevFest is Google's global series of developer-led, community events — and DevFest Yaoundé is our local chapter's flagship gathering, run by GDG Yaoundé for the people building things in and around this city. wallTerms.title: Community wall terms
wallTerms.metaDesc: What we store when you save a DevFest card, how long it stays, and how to take it down.
wallTerms.lead: Short version: we keep a smaller copy of the composed card, not the photo from your camera roll, and you can take it down any time.
wallTerms.storedBody: When you download, share or copy a card, we save a smaller JPEG of the composed card (about 640px), the display name you typed, the time, the style, and the wording of the notice you were shown. The original photo never leaves your device. No GPS, no camera serial — it is drawn on a canvas and re-encoded here.
wallTerms.whereBody: On the public Community Wall, unless you take it down or an organiser hides it. The wall is not offered to search engines.
wallTerms.howTitle: How to take a card down
wallTerms.howBody: Write gdgyaounde@gmail.com and say which nickname or which picture. There is no button on the wall — an organiser will hide or delete it.
wallTerms.children: Do not put a card of a child on the wall. If you see one, write gdgyaounde@gmail.com.

terms.title: Participation terms
terms.metaDesc: What each DevFest Yaoundé pass includes — free or paid —, entry and badges, food and swag, ticket changes, photos and the code of conduct.
terms.lead: DevFest Yaoundé is a day out with friends who build things. Here's what each pass includes, in plain words — so nobody gets a surprise on Saturday.
terms.whatBody: A free community event, run by volunteers from GDG Yaoundé (Google Developer Group). The talks, the workshops, the sponsor stands and the community are open to everyone with a pass — free (Haikyu) or paid.
terms.passesTitle: Free vs paid passes: what each includes
terms.passesBody: Pulled straight from our ticket tiers, so it's always current. Prices include the transaction fee.
terms.foodRule: Food and drinks, swag (T-shirts, goodies, stickers…), event identifiers (badge, lanyard, bracelet or similar) and every other physical perk are for paid pass holders — Sonnet, Opus, Fable and Mythos — and only for what their tier includes. A free pass gives no claim to any of them, including if there's some left at the end of the day.
terms.foodWhy: It's not about who deserves what: paid passes are what pays for exactly these things. The free pass gets you the essentials — the content and the community — and a certificate of participation.
terms.entryFree: A free pass gets you in: the talks, the workshops (within each room's capacity) and the sponsor stands.
terms.entryNoBadge: It doesn't guarantee a physical identifier — no badge, lanyard, bracelet or similar. The team may hand some out on the day, but with a free pass, best not to count on one.
terms.entryPaid: Paid passes get theirs: it's part of the tier.
terms.changesBody: You can change your ticket's name and T-shirt size from your account until {date} at {time} (Yaoundé time). After that, everything goes to print — write to us if something's wrong.
terms.refundsBody: A paid ticket can't be refunded or cancelled, but you can put it in someone else's name before the day. The free pass is just an RSVP on Bevy: nothing to refund — if you can't make it, free up your spot for someone else.
terms.photosBody: We take photos and video during the day to tell the story afterwards. Pictures made with the DP generator and shared on the community wall follow their own rules.
terms.conductBody: DevFest Yaoundé follows the Google Developer Groups community's participation terms and code of conduct. By coming, you agree to them: kindness, respect, zero harassment. Anyone who doesn't may be asked to leave, whatever their pass.
terms.contactBody: Write to us — we answer fast, especially this week.

common.offline: You're offline — nothing can be checked. Use the printed list until the connection is back.
common.cameraIdle: Point the camera at the QR code on the attendee's ticket.
common.cameraDenied: Camera access was blocked. Allow it in the browser's site settings, or type codes below.
common.cameraUnavailable: No camera available on this device — type codes below.
common.cameraFailed: The camera wouldn't start. Try again, or type codes below.
common.typeHint: It's printed under the QR: DFY-XXXXX-XXXXX. Case and dashes don't matter.
common.invalidBody: Codes look like DFY-XXXXX-XXXXX — ten letters and digits after DFY.
common.notBadgeTitle: That QR isn't a DevFest ticket
common.notBadgeBody: Ask them to open the ticket itself — in their account or in the receipt email.
common.forbiddenTitle: You're signed out, or your access has ended
common.forbiddenBody: Sign in again with the account an organiser added. If it still fails, call an organiser.
common.networkBody: It may or may not have gone through. Retry — if it then says “already” a moment ago, that was this same scan.
common.serverBody: Nothing was recorded. Retry, or call an organiser.
common.notFoundBody: Check the code with them, or find them by name below. Free passes taken on Bevy have no code here — they don't need one to get in.
common.searchTitle: No code? Find them by name
common.searchEmpty: No ticket under that name. Free passes taken on Bevy aren't listed.
common.searchFailed: The search didn't go through. Try again.

door.title: Door check-in
door.alreadyBody: First scanned at {time} ({ago}). If this isn't the same person, ask for ID and call an organiser.
door.paidIncludes: Paid pass — meal and swag included
door.refunded: Refunded — entry only, no meal or swag
door.refundPending: A refund request is open for this ticket. Tell an organiser they came in.

perks.title: Meal & swag
perks.alreadyBody: Collected at {time} ({ago}). One per pass — call an organiser if something's wrong.
perks.reasonFreePass: Free pass: entry only — no meal, no swag.
perks.reasonRefunded: This ticket was refunded: entry only.
perks.reasonNotInPass: This pass doesn't include it. Call an organiser if they disagree.
perks.noSize: No T-shirt size on file — ask them.

merch.title: Merch pickup
merch.intro: Search by the buyer's name, or the order number shown on their account page (#XXXXXXXX).
merch.empty: No pickup order matches. Orders being shipped aren't listed here.
merch.conflict: Someone just updated this order — search again.
merch.already: This order was already handed over.
merch.cannot: This order can't be handed over here — call an organiser.

reservations.title: Reserved online? Find the reservation
reservations.hint: Type the reference (RES-XXXXXX) or at least 3 letters of the name.
reservations.empty: No reservation under that. Walk-ins pay at the table.
reservations.cancelled: This reservation was cancelled. Don't take cash for it — call an organiser.

reservations.shopReserving: Online payments are closed. Reserve your items now — you pay in cash when you collect them at the venue.
reservations.shopDoor: Reservations are closed. Pay in cash at the venue — items are available while stock lasts.
reservations.bagTitleReserving: Your bag is now a reservation
reservations.bagBodyReserving: Online payments are closed, so nothing is paid on the site. Add your name and pick your tickets and items on the reservation page — you pay in cash at the venue.
reservations.bagBodyDoor: Come to {venue} and pay in cash on the spot — items are available while stock lasts.

salesPopup.sellingBody: Tickets and the shop can only be paid on the site until then ({date}). After that, nothing is paid online: you reserve your spot until {reserveDate} at {reserveTime}, and pay in cash at the venue.
salesPopup.reservingTitle: Online payments are closed — reserve your spot
salesPopup.reservingBody: Nothing is paid on the site any more. Reserve your tickets and any shop items until {date} at {time}, then pay in cash at the venue.
salesPopup.doorBody: Reservations are closed. Come to {venue} on {date} and pay in cash on the spot.

agendaPopup.title: Our agenda is live
agendaPopup.body: The full programme for {date} is online: five rooms, talks, workshops, a pitch contest and more. Check it out and plan your day.

partnersPopup.title: Welcome to our new partners
partnersPopup.body: A big thank you to Impact Hub Yaoundé, our incubator partner, who will welcome the two winners of the Pitch Contest into its programme, and to the Tech Innovation Center (TiC), our venue partner. This edition is better because of them.

testimonial.metaDesc: Leave a few anonymous words about DevFest Yaoundé.
testimonial.prompt: What has DevFest Yaoundé meant to you?
testimonial.label: Your words
testimonial.errorShort: A few more words? At least {min} characters.
testimonial.errorRate: You've shared a lot already — take a breath and try again later.
testimonial.errorGeneric: Something glitched on our end — give it another shot?
testimonial.thanksTitle: Thank you. Your words are part of our story now.
testimonial.thanksBody: No name, no account — just what you wrote. Once the team has read it, it may appear on the wall.
testimonial.welcomeBody: Let's look back at the road we've travelled together.
